correctness.rationale: Independent rate-one type processes couple exactly to discrete coupon labels; cover time C_N=max first arrival has exact max-exponential CDF and bounded centered fourth moment. For each threshold j, empirical Gamma(j,1) tail has uniform-in-time DKW error O(N^−1/2), and there are only O(√logN) distinct thresholds on a fixed x-window; the union-bound L² supremum is o(1/logN). The Poisson CDF derivative equals minus its boundary pmf, with uniform local CLT giving √logN times derivative→−φ(x); bounded max pmf and centered cover fourth moments promote linearization to L². Optional isometry of total-rate-N Poisson martingale gives E|(T_N/N)−C_N|²=H_N/N→0. The uniform functional remainder and Gumbel moment convergence imply joint law and covariance. Finite companion code was inspected but is not the asymptotic proof.
